previous_assumption: The organizations module had no way to list organizations by type, and the Quotation-creation form's raw "Renter organization ID" UUID input plus missing Requirement context were assumed to need either a new organizations sub-app/module or no real fix at all ("too CRM-like" to build).
correction: Fixed by the smallest additive path: added `OrganizationRepositoryPort.listByType(organizationTypeCode)` (join organizations->organization_types) and exposed it as `CommercialQuotationService.listRenterOrganizations` (gated by the existing `quotation.manage` permission) via a new `GET /organizations/:organizationId/renter-organizations` route living in the commercial-quotation module — no new organizations-module presentation layer was created, since this is a narrow counterparty-picker lookup, not a general org directory. The frontend now: (1) fetches the Requirement via the existing (but previously unused by the frontend) `getRequirementForDiscovery` route and renders it as read-only context above the create-quotation form, resolving productSubcategoryId to a name by reusing the existing category/subcategory list endpoints (no new catalogue endpoint needed); (2) replaces the raw UUID `Input` with a real `Select` fed by `listRenterOrganizations`; (3) when arriving from a Requirement, locks the renter organization as a hidden input (not a disabled `<select>` — disabled fields are excluded from `FormData` on submit, so a plain read-only text display + hidden input is required, not `disabled`). Also found and fixed a real pre-existing bug while doing this: `CommercialQuotationService.createQuotation` accepted a `requirementId` and a `renterOrganizationId` independently with no cross-check, so a caller could submit a requirementId from Renter A alongside a renterOrganizationId for Renter B; added a guard rejecting a mismatch. Also fixed a related display bug in the quotations list itself (`QuotationRow`'s "Customer" column still showed a truncated raw UUID) by threading the same renter-organizations lookup into the list view.
